summary.text: Jim Guthrie is a Republican who represents District 28 in the Idaho Senate and is listed in Guthrie's seventh term; the directory lists Guthrie's occupation as rancher and business owner.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography says Guthrie served one term in the Idaho House, 2010 to 2012, and was born in Pocatello and graduated from Marsh Valley High School.
It also lists service on the Marsh Valley School District board of trustees (1995-2001) and as a Bannock County commissioner (2001-2007).
